narrative: Severity medium: the D0122/D0125 dig fix itself is unaffected (it never touched grounded_no_floor's cause), and the 59 bound stays correct as a measured ceiling regardless of which mechanism produces each occurrence -- what changes is the CAUSAL STORY the ledger told about why. The real split (55 resolve_floor / 4 grid_floor_backstop) suggests the dominant contributor is the heightfield ground-plane resolver disagreeing with grid-solidity's own floor predicate at FLOOR_ROW-height transitions -- a different, so-far-unnamed edge case, not primarily D0059f's pit-lip case as previously claimed. This FINDING does not reopen D0122 (already closed) or change the bound; it corrects the prose explanation two prior entries gave for a number that itself remains correct.
observation: docs/DECISIONS_LEDGER.md D0127/D0128 state that all 91 grounded_no_floor violations (32 dig-off + 59 dig-on) share the same _grid_floor_backstop/D0059f pit-lip mechanism, based solely on every occurrence sharing pos_y=14417920 (HostileChamber.FLOOR_ROW height). An external (Codex) audit correctly identified this as overstated: the fuzz probe's own telemetry recorded position and predicate failure only, never which code path actually set on_floor=true, so shared height is evidence of a shared LOCATION, not a shared CODE PATH. D0132's own grounding-path telemetry (Body.floor_source_this_tick), built specifically to answer this, now shows the claim is not merely unproven but actively wrong for most of the population: of the 59 dig-on violations in the 498-seed/1500-tick reproducing prefix, 55 trace to resolve_floor (the normal heightfield ground-plane resolver) and only 4 trace to grid_floor_backstop (the mechanism D0127/D0128 named as THE cause of all of them).
